Project and examples: https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/examples/
License: Apache-2.0; see LICENSE and asset-specific licenses.
Bundled unchanged: legacy/build/pdf.min.mjs (renamed pdf.mjs),
legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs (renamed pdf.worker.mjs), cmaps,
standard_fonts and wasm. No source maps, sample documents or PDF scripting sandbox.
Private ticket bytes are supplied in memory; resources are served from this site.
